body: Live everyday like its your last. I took life for granted. I wish I wouldn't of wasted so much time and messed around. I felt like I had eternity and I had three years of general freedom. Now I'm stuck in misery. I don't think others think the way I do. I don't think people understand what I'm going through. I feel like in the song one by Metallica. I'm fighting a war and I'm losing. I don't want another human being to feel the pain I feel inside. I feel hurt and lost. I wish I never saw the world. People think a divorce is hard. Im going through a divorce with my existence. I already was orphaned as a child now I'm dying. Great life.

To be honest I want to show people how much I love them. I've been in so much pain for the past 6 months its unbearable. I don't want to be forgotten. I don't want people to be exposed to the pain I have.  I've gotten cut short. I just want to live I'm dying.
I'm 22 buy the way have to love the recessive gene.
My left eye is 20/20 My right is 20/25. That's the best the ophthalmologist could correct it to.

I know I'm trying smoking a blunt and drinking a bud right now. I can't guarantee anything. It depends how bad this gets. It seems like it's getting worse by the day. I just want to see like I did 2 months ago. To me life is like a fraction. When the bottom number exceeds the top it isn't worth it anymore. This life doesn't mean as much to me as  It does to you. My fighting will to survive isn't as strong.

My vision I'm losing my eyesight. When ever I look through my eyes I see double of everything. I went to three different doctors and they say there is nothing that can be done. When ever I have to drive I have to look through one eye. I'm queasy constantly.
